title: VECELO Corner Desk Computer Desk Writing Table with Smooth Keyboard Tray & Storage Shelves,Compact Home Office Triangle Table,Antique Brown

reviews.title: Perfect small desk and great quality!
reviews.body: This desk is perfect for a small space. The quality is good, it was easy to build, and it looks exactly like the picture. If you need a good small desk, purchase this one!!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 23, 2026
reviews.author: Anita

reviews.title: Great Desk. Perfect Space Saving Design.
reviews.body: My dad needed a new computer desk so I bought this one for him. It fit perfectly into the space where his old desk was set up. The triangular design is great for fitting a desk into the corner of a room. It was fairly easy to put together.... the majority of the screws could be tightened down with the two included Allen Wrenches.... however the 4 screws included to screw on the keyboard tray to the sliders were Phillips head screws and they do not include a Phillips head screwdriver... luckily we had (and could find) a Phillips head screw driver that worked to tighten down the screws... so make sure you have one before you set out to put this together.The hardest part was flipping it upright and maneuvering it into the space but that's mostly because I had to do most of the heavy lifting as my dad is disabled but if you had a second set of hands it's really not that heavy.It has plenty of desk space for knickknacks and whatever else you want to decorate your desk with since the keyboard can go on the slide out keyboard tray.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 9, 2024
reviews.author: MarvelTheatreGirl

reviews.title: Sturdy, Compact, but roomier than expected
reviews.body: Fits perfectly in small corner of my den but desktop is roomy enough for my laptop, an external drive, and my paired bluetooth speaker.  The desk feels more sturdy than I expected.  But the deal breaker for me when comparing this desk with similar desks was the spacious keyboard tray.  The shelf where I can keep my laptop carrying case along with a small basket for speaker charger and a couple other items is a bonus.  I am glad I chose this one instead of the others I was considering.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 3, 2026
reviews.author: Debra

reviews.title: Great corner desk!
reviews.body: This desk was perfect for what I needed. It's well made and easy enough to put together. Arrived in good shape with no damage. A 2nd person would be helpful for putting the shelves in, but isn't a necessity. Fits perfectly in my corner. I have a 27" monitor on top and still have plenty of room for working. Keyboard tray was what sold me on this particular desk.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 4, 2025
reviews.author: GatorGirl

reviews.title: Great little space-saving desk
reviews.body: I purchased this desk because I have other furniture from the same line and I like the look.  This little desk does NOT disappoint!  Seems easy enough to assemble- I was lucky enough to have my husband do it and i didnt hear much yelling lol.  It looks way more expensive than it is.  I have had a few other "build out of the box" type desks,  and at the same price point,  this one looks much more stylish.  With our daughter away at college,  we decided to transform her room into a spare bedroom/office.  This desk fits perfectly in the corner-  its saves quite a bit of space and we are still able to keep her bed in there without feeling crowded.  It seems sturdy enough,  although we only have a laptop on there.  The sliding keyboard tray doesnt slide out as smoothly as I'd like,  but a little bit of silicone spray seemed to do the trick.  Other than that,  this was the perfect solution for us- small,  functional,  stylish and at a decent price!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 9, 2022

reviews.title: Perfect for small spaces
reviews.body: I love this desk.  It works perfectly in the corner of my living room.  I can do my homework without feeling isolated from the rest of the house.  It is sturdy enough for my computer, my things and my cat to sit on comfortably.  It was a great price for a good quality item.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 17, 2025
reviews.author: Amelia Luker

reviews.title: Wrong color, but a fairly decent desk for the price.
reviews.body: First off will be my slight complaint.  I ordered the black version of the desk and received the wood grain version.  It's a minor thing and besides not fitting the overall look of the room, it's a whatever for me.  I'm going to use it regardless.As for the desk itself.  First as others have mentioned, it's clearly not actual MDF.  It came in good shape and put together mostly fine besides my accidentally dropping the wrong size screw into the leg frame.  Mostly fine meaning that I'd for sure build it on a soft surface.  Just flipping it after building it gave it a slight scuff.  My monitor stand covers it so again not a big deal to me.It does feels somewhat flimsy at first, but after putting it into place in the corner of my room it gained much more stability.  It also offers a ton of leg room.  Both the width and length.  Much more than my 40+ year old desk did.Overall I'm happy with the purchase with my only real complaint being delivery of the wrong color.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 22, 2023
reviews.author: Jason Murdock
